steps.text: If the player has level 1-14 Smithing:

steps.player: Can you teach me the basics of smelting please?

steps.text: Look for this icon on your minimap to find a furnace to smelt ores into metal.
If the player has no ore in their inventory:

steps.npc: You'll need to have mined some ore to smelt first. Go see the mining tutor to the south if you're not sure how to do this.

steps.text: Look for this icon to the south of here, in the swamp.
If the player has ore in their inventory:

steps.npc: I see you have some ore with you to smelt, so let's get started.
Click on the furnace to bring up a menu of metal bars you can try to make from your ore.
When you have a full inventory, take it to the bank, you can find it on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge.

steps.text: To find a bank, look for this symbol on your minimap after climbing the stairs of the Lumbridge Castle to the top. There are banks all over the world with this symbol.

steps.npc: If you have a hammer with you, you can smith the bronze bars into equipment on the anvil outside.
I'm afraid the weather over the years has rusted it down, so it can only be used to work bronze.
Alternatively you can run up to Varrock. Look for my Master, the Smithing Tutor, in the west of the city, he can help you smith better gear.

steps.text: If the player has level 16-28 Smithing:

steps.player: I already know about the basics of smelting, got any tips?

steps.npc: I find it useful to stockpile my ore before smelting it in one go, or even do it on the way to the bank in such places as Al Kharid or Falador. But you can do it anyway you want, one load at a time is fine too!
Not too much can go wrong with smelting.
You will lose some iron when smelting that ore, but a Ring of Forging or the Superheat Item spell will soon solve that.
You should also investigate Keldagrim, the dwarven city, you may find better places to smelt your ore with friends.

steps.text: If the player has level 29-99 Smithing:

steps.player: What do I do after smelting the ore?

steps.npc: Ahh you'll need to learn to smith. Go to Varrock, that's where my master, the Smithing Tutor, plies his trade. Ask him to teach you how to smith.

steps.text: Look for this icon in the west of Varrock.

steps.npc: Smelt some ore and store it in the bank. Grab a hammer from the general store before you go too!
